Cloudflare hosting performance

Cloudflare hosting injects a Cloudflare Insights (RUM) beacon separately from Google Analytics. It may send page performance metrics, URLs and referrers to Cloudflare. Cloudflare documents that the beacon uses no cookies or browser storage and discards the request IP address at its nearest data center. This site’s Google Analytics control does not control the hosting beacon. Script presence does not establish successful metric delivery.

Preference storage limits

If local storage fails, denial can apply to this tab while session storage works. If both fail, denial applies only to this page. Other tabs or browsers may differ.
